6. The informant has stated in the FIR that Swarna Khan had purchased the disputed land by a kabala dated 5-7-1986 and obtained mutation and paid rent. However the purchaser Swarna Khan used to live at the Khathal Bagan area of the Dhaka City. So he was not able to take care of the land regularly. By taking advantage of this situation, the accused Nurun Nabi Firoj created a false exchange deed of 1991-92 and illegally raised a hut on that land and started living there. Being so dispossessed, the purchaser Swarna Khan filed an application under section 30 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Rules, 1955 (shortly the Rules, 1955) and got the record of right prepared in his name. Thereafter the usurper Nurun Nabi Firoj filed an application under rule 31 of the Rules, 1955. On receipt of this application, the then Appeal Officer being accused Ashraf Ali Howlader, without examining the relevant documents, passed an order dated 27-11-2002 for correction of the record in favour of the usurper Nurun Nabi Firoj. 

 13. Mr. Rahman, the learned Advocate, next submits that the period of occurrence as stated in the charge, namely 27-11-2002 হতে 05-3-2007 is a very unspecified time. 

 15. Mr. Rahman lastly submits that if this kind of prosecution is allowed no public officer can discharge their statutory duty with regard to preparation and revision of record under a statute like the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 and the Rules, 1955 made thereunder, because most of the decisions involve conflicting interests and hence likely to affect the interest of some person. 

 16. In support of his submission the learned Advocate refers to the observation of a Division Bench of this Court in the case of Ayubur Rahman (Md)-Vs.- State represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka reported in 56 DLR(2004), page-281. 

 18. Mr. Haque, the learned Advocate, next draws our attention to the statements of the 3 witnesses recorded under section 161 Cr.P.0 and the departmental enquiry report dated 5-7-2010 prepared by the Charge Officer and submits that in this report there is a vivid description as to how the two accused Appeal Officers, in connoivance with the co-accused Surveyer Monirul Islam, harassed the lawful purchaser Swarna Khan, and as to how an illegal usurper of the land being accused Nurun Nabi Feroj was able to get a fraudulent entry in the record of right. 

 23. It is noted that the various chapters of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, contain a specific provision with regard to bar on the jurisdiction of Civil Courts in respect of the actions taken under the respective chapter and thus gives protection to the Revenue Officers including the land Survey Department officials from civil liability. But the Act, 1950 or the Rules. 1955 are silent about protection from criminal liability.

 30. On the second issue, that is the propriety of the charge framed against the accused petitioners on the basis of the available materials, we have examined all the materials on record of the trial Court, namely the F.I.R., charge sheet, the statements of the 3 witness cited in the charge sheet as recorded by the Investigating Officer under section 161 Cr.P.C. and the record of Appeal No. 25804/11 including the তদন্ত প্রতিবেদন sent by the Charge Officer (তদন্ত) under স্মারক  841 dated 5-7-2010 to his higher authority. 

 32. The allegations stated in the charge indicate correction of the record of right during the period 27-11-2002 হতে 05-03-2007, but without any reference to specific decision or the manner or process of the decision that was taken by the concerned accused in the concerned file. These particulars are necessary because the role played by the 3(three) accused persons were not the same.
